title: Onboarding and wiki links refreshed
summary: Gave the Server Guide a minimalistic redesign, reworded Onboarding questions, updated resource channels, and fixed /wiki embed links.
description: Refreshed the Server Guide, reworded Onboarding questions to sound more human, updated resource channels, and repaired /wiki embed title links.

body.text: Updated the Server Guide — removed the old images and replaced them with a clean, minimalistic design.
Reworded the Onboarding questions so they sound more human and friendly.
Updated the resource channels to point to more relevant places.
Fixed the link behind the embed's title from /wiki article keyword searches.
